name: rationale-toolkit
description: Rationale-first coding style and outcome-verification discipline for Claude Code and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Reusable skills for explaining design choices, reviewing code, and verifying outcomes before declaring work complete, plus a pre-tool hook that blocks direct node_modules/.bin/ invocations in favour of a system command or a package-manager runner.
defaultPrompt: Use Rationale Toolkit when writing or reviewing code.
Verify the outcome of this change before finishing.
